scope: Fix observed long-log exploration before further paid cases

observation.cause: Whole-log paging accumulated five large excerpts before source investigation; next request exceeded token admission.

implementation: Reuse read_log: bounded single-line literal lookup, up to 16 surrounding lines, original encoding/warnings and line anchors, explicit next occurrence.
Readback navigation uses the returned physical range for query mode; ordinary range receipts retain their previous interpretation.
Shared guidance prioritizes exception and application frames, then upstream source and an early supported candidate; uncertainty never forces a fabricated patch.
Source list/search accept benign directory trailing slashes while retaining absolute-path, traversal and internal normalization rejection.
first_checks: A prior test treated directory trailing slash as invalid; replaced that expectation with an explicit traversal case and added valid-slash coverage. Ruff import layout corrected. A continuation default-range issue was found and tested before any new model request.

existing_real_result.limitation: No executable verification; different runs and caps do not establish a controlled method improvement.

environment: Existing managed runtime only; no dependencies, platform installation, global setting or resource-limit changes.
next: Independent EnterpriseRecruitment2 retry, remaining cases, minimal-diff retests, then separate robustness matrix and selected-run statistics.
